messages:
alex.li: Quick design ping — I uploaded a new Figma frame for the notification matrix / suppression preview. TL;DR: we want an in-console "Preview" that simulates the exact notifications each channel would receive (payload, truncated vs full body, badge state). link: https://figma.redwood/notify-matrix-v2 :eyes: maria.g: Nice — could you call out the exact scenarios the preview covers? e.g. single-channel alert, multi-channel (email+slack), and suppression windows (mute rules). alex.li: Yep. The doc lists three sims: 1) baseline alert -> primary channel only, 2) multi-channel fanout with per-channel templating, 3) suppressed -> preview shows "would not send" state and greyed out card. I added a small dropdown to pick the incident severity so designers can see different payload variants. jonathan: UX nit: the suppression control is currently a pill that says "Muted for 30m". Users kept asking if it's overriding all channels or just the channel-level mute. Can we change copy to "Suppression: All channels — 30m" vs a per-channel badge? alex.li: Good call. I sketched two options: global suppression banner vs inline channel pill. The matrix preview will show both states. Prefer consistency with how we display routing rules elsewhere. sophie: Accessibility: the preview cards have low contrast for the "would not send" state (light gray text on white). We need AA contrast for body + label. Also keyboard users should be able to iterate channels with arrow keys when the matrix is open. accessibility-pat: +1 on contrast. Suggested colors: use #6B7280 (text) on #FFFFFF is borderline; move to #4B5563. Also add ARIA-live region when preview changes so screen reader users hear "Preview updated: would send to Slack, would not send to Email". kyle: Copy thought: instead of "Suppression" maybe "Muted window" or "Silence window"? "Suppression" is a little technical for some product managers. We should run quick preferred wording with PMs. maria.g: Agree on copy check. For the preview card statuses I like short verbs: "Will send", "Suppressed", "Fallbacked". Avoid long phrases. jonathan: Edge case: what happens when a channel has both a mute and a per-channel routing rule that downgrades severity? The preview should show the effective pipeline (mute -> no send; downgrade -> send with low-priority template). Can we show a tiny provenance line: "reason: mute" or "reason: route -> low-priority"? alex.li: Added a subtle provenance line in the mock under the event header. It uses a lighter color and an info icon. Click expands to show rule IDs. Thoughts about exposing rule IDs in UI? sophie: Exposing rule IDs in the expanded view is fine for debugging. Make sure the rule details are accessible and copyable. design-bot: alex.li uploaded new frame: notify-matrix-v2 — updated preview states and aria notes. accessibility-pat: Quick ARIA snippet suggestion for the preview region: ```
``` Also ensure channel toggles have `aria-checked` and are reachable by `tabindex` in DOM order. kyle: Regarding keyboard flow — when the preview modal opens, focus should land on the severity dropdown, then tab goes to channel list, then to preview. Arrow keys move within the channel list. Escape closes modal. maria.g: UX question — should the preview simulate rate-limiting/fallbacks (e.g., if Slack returns 429, show fallback to email)? That might be confusing in a design mock unless we label it as "simulated failure" mode. Could add a checkbox "Simulate failure" for advanced preview. jonathan: I like the simulate-failure toggle for engineering handoffs. It would help product + SRE understand graceful degradation behavior. Default off. alex.li: Updated Figma with simulate-failure checkbox and a small legend explaining statuses. Also tweaked suppression copy to "Muted (All channels) — 30m" for global and "Muted — 30m" for channel-level. sophie: One more a11y note: color is not the only indicator — add an icon and text for "Suppressed" vs "Will send". Screen readers need text, and colorblind needs iconography. accessibility-pat: Agreed. Use check/exclamation icons plus the short verb text. Also include `aria-describedby` pointing to the provenance line when expanded. maria.g: I'll run a quick copy A/B with PMs tomorrow: options: "Muted (All channels)", "Silenced for 30 minutes", "Suppressed: 30m". Will post results here. alex.li: Thanks everyone. Action items: 1) maria run copy poll, 2) pat run contrast + screen reader pass, 3) jonathan/spec write expected precedence rules for preview, 4) kyle wire keyboard interactions. I'll iterate frames later today. :sparkles:
